تستقبحون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِحُونَ (tastaqbiḥūna) /tas.taq.bi.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# تُسْتَقْبَحُونَ (tustaqbaḥūna) /tus.taq.ba.ħuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
